# Synths
[color=#ffa500]Warning! This species is not recommended for new players due to major gameplay changes![/color]
Synths are a species of artificial humanoids vaguely resembling bipedal lizards, who are maintained through a combination of known complex machinery and organic flesh treatment methods.
## Racial Features
- They can speak and understand Galactic Common and EAL. - They rely on an internal battery, which can be [color=yellow]replaced via surgery[/color]. Mechanical functions will be [color=yellow]impaired[/color] if it reaches 0% charge. - In addition to an internal battery, they feature a miniature bioreactor, which processes organic mass to generate power and facilitates autonomous bodily repair. Mechanical functions will be [color=yellow]impaired[/color] if not maintained. - Healing sources are [color=red]50% less effective[/color] on Synths, but internal nanites allow them to passively recover from Brute, Burn, and Cellular damage at the cost of satiation. Autonomous repairs are [color=yellow]slow[/color] and will eventually [color=red]starve[/color] the bioreactor if not maintained. - They contain fullerene, a carbon-based, blood-like solution, which assists their internal nanites in performing repairs. Autonomous repairs will [color=yellow]slow down[/color] as fullerene reserves deplete. - Due to its complexity, it is impossible to inject reagents directly into Synth bloodstreams, rendering oral administration [color=yellow]necessary for metabolization[/color]. Needles and hyposprays [color=red]will not work[/color]! - Metabolized Carbon helps restore depleted fullerene. In the event of an emergency, [color=yellow]replacement fullerene packs[/color] can be fabricated at a medical techfab, requiring diamonds. - They receive [color=#8147ff]40% more Shock damage[/color], [color=#B9BF93]25% less Blunt damage[/color], [color=#B9BF93]10% less Slash damage[/color], [color=#ffa500]5% more Piercing damage[/color], [color=#B9BF93]15% less Heat damage[/color], [color=#1e90ff]40% less Cold damage[/color], and [color=#B9BF93]20% less Radiation damage[/color]. - Despite being a machine species, Synths are [color=#C8FF75]not immune to Cellular damage[/color]. However, normal sources [color=yellow]do not[/color] have the same effect on Synths as they do organics. Instead, [color=red]Synths receive Cellular damage when receiving Shock damage[/color]. - EMPs are [color=red]dangerous[/color] but not lethal, capable of [color=yellow]completely depleting their internal battery[/color]. Additionally, Synths receive extra Shock damage when hit and suffer temporary movement impairment and blindness.
## Central Computing Unit
- Synth CCUs function similarly to positronic brains and can be [color=yellow]directly inserted into a cyborg chassis[/color]. MMI not supported, but due to having an integrated voice module, Synth CCUs can [color=yellow]communicate outside of a chassis[/color].
## Nanites
- Nanites function as the most effective means of treatment for Synth injuries, despite a [color=red]dangerous OD at >10.5 units[/color], and can be [color=yellow]created via chemistry[/color] using an [color=yellow]electrolysis[/color] machine. [color=red]Warning! Nanites are incredibly lethal to organic species and should be handled with extreme caution![/color]
